pr_title: Adjust legacy catcher display to match 1:1 with osu!(stable)
pr_body: - Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/18968 - Supersedes #24895 (see [this comment](https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/25070#issuecomment-1754073787) though) ## [Adjust catcher origin position to match 1:1 with stable](https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/25070/commits/0fb7895a52c8b3fd9cd374e34c603afa4b7396ec) The catcher's origin position is now distributed to each skin implementation rather than having a rough approximation set at a higher-level component. This allows the legacy skin implementation to directly follow suit with stable. I've adjusted the argon implementation to set the origin point to the centre rather than passing over the approximated origin position from `SkinnableCatcher`, adjusting layout slightly. Since the catcher's origin position is no longer set at a high level, I had thought scaling will break because the origin position is set to a lower level than the scale, but...*surprisingly*, scaling still respects the origin position: https://github.com/ppy/osu/assets/22781491/e0397a25-72c8-4d1b-bbb1-f0f98512d60c (notice the catcher is scaling up while maintaining the top's plate position, rather than sliding down) I've kept the code as-is, but if it feels off and unexpected, I can reconsider. ## [Fix legacy catcher sprites getting shrunk](https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/25070/commits/fc63ee43be2a75d39f16606e85f53e1135022027) Currently in master, catcher sprites were being downscaled to fit the catcher's true catching region, which doesn't look to sit well with many skins. In stable, catcher sprites are displayed with their raw size, only scaled down by constant factors that are described within the code (see `LegacyCatcher`). ## [Adjust the catch playfield's position to match 1:1 with stable](https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/25070/commits/b2987caf7cc56248ba6638fc7d9b34708f96c80a) & [Refactor catch playfield size adjustment logic w.r.t. catcher position](https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/25070/commits/6073f3e756536d6765cf18a3cc34196bc15d464a) These changes adjust the playfield positioning in order for the catcher to still be correctly displayed on screen without looking pushed too much down. I've made them as detailed as possible, with some rewords to touch on things that got me confused at first when reading the previous code. --- Overall, here are visual cross-comparisons of the catcher's display between lazer and stable: | master | this PR | |--------|---------| | | | (beatmap, for reference: https://osu.ppy.sh/beatmapsets/972887#fruits/2036865) Note that the fruits look to be at different Y positions at those specific time stamps. It's hard to figure out the exact frame and cross-compare it, but at least this PR doesn't affect the Y position at roughly similar timestamps, compared to master (this might indicate that the changes in here are not enough and there is something off, but I'll leave that outside the PR, as it goes beyond the scope of the issue thread that this PR is trying to resolve).
pr_comments: I wanted to split the other change that was in #24895 to a follow-up PR, but I've noticed that this PR alone causes a difference in the catcher's position, so it cannot proceed forward without pushing the other changes as well.

issue_context.title: osu!catch catcher size does not match stable
issue_context.body:
Without checking the code, I believe this change was made to be more "correct". But if that's the case, it shouldn't be applied to classic skins as it is not what the user has come to expect (and many skins account for this in their textures). ### Discussed in https://github.com/ppy/osu/discussions/18870
Originally posted by **Doxxz** June 27, 2022 ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/67333710/175897370-9e92e029-50df-4f33-bc10-37a34a69bed3.png) ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/67333710/175897507-dcbd4c79-5ea3-43a5-9049-f8079d45fa3d.png) Is this intended?
comments: The issue thread description looks to hint towards a discussion of whether the catcher size should be changed in default/lazer skins as well. But, since it's just a number, I think it's saner to match stable regardless of the skin and call it a day.

> But, since it's just a number, I think it's saner to match stable regardless of the skin and call it a day.

What, why? If lazer's number is in fact "more correct" in some respect (in that it reflects the true catcher range or whatever) then surely this is a chance to _keep_ the thing more correct for new skins, and just revert to the old behaviour in old skins?

Requires investigation as to what the reason for this discrepancy is specifically (if any).
Hmm, right, I wasn't sure what the term "correct" was referring to, but that's a valid point. I'll wait for a response then (cc @peppy).

I think this should be applied in legacy skins for now. Because in newer skins I think we'll want the drawable size to match correctly so we can show the catcher area without hacking in weird paddings.

review_comments: This had to be turned off since skin implementations can be of different sizes now, and should be positioned from top-centre of the catcher's boundary, rather than the centre.
